test_scalar_graph_creation: test creating a scalar graph with a random weight and verify arc count, labels, nodes, and weights
test_linear_graph_creation: test creating a linear graph with M rows and N columns and verify node count and arc count
run_gtn_scalar_graph: run gtn.scalar_graph to create a graph from a single weight value with optional gradient calculation
